capabilities: Organize chapters into novel groups, volumes, and article groups
Manage chapter statuses and drag-and-drop ordering in an article list
Write in a plain-text novel editor with auto formatting and pending-revision blocks
Maintain setting collections, records, and a materials library
Find and replace across a chapter, volume, or book
disambiguation: Not a reading or preview mode; it is a novel-writing workspace with article lists, setting collections, and a plain-text editor.
extras: Desktop-only; stores group configuration in novel.json and setting data in hidden index.md files, with automatic migration from legacy NovelSetting.md and -设定/index.json.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer and Markdown editor do not provide a structured workflow for long-form fiction, so organizing chapters, volumes, settings, and revisions becomes cumbersome.
summary: Novel-writing workspace that adds novel groups, an article tree with volumes and groups, a plain-text editor, setting collections, materials, and find/replace.
